answer: Essays alone cannot resist Sybils: one operator can grow a juniper thicket of fluent identities at near-zero cost, adding each new vertex to the referral graph with cheap text. Make fakes expensive and audits cheap instead: require a small bonded stake, give blind graders hidden gold-standard cases, and slash stakes when audits catch rubber-stamping. Let rewards settle slowly, like sap hardening into crystal, so a colluding cluster is exposed and loses its bond before payout rather than after.
